STMemoryBooks_RpgMemoryModeEnabled: Enable automatic RPG campaign memory mode
STMemoryBooks_RpgMemoryModeDesc: Uses Auto-Summary as the first campaign memory engine while RPG-specific memory tools are added.
STMemoryBooks_RpgAutomationPolicyDesc: Choose whether campaign memory updates happen silently or wait for review.
STMemoryBooks_RpgContentTriggersEnabled: Trigger RPG memories from campaign events
STMemoryBooks_RpgContentTriggersDesc: Creates RPG memories early when the recent chat contains important canon, quest, entity, relationship, location, or explicit remember-this signals. The fixed interval remains a fallback.
STMemoryBooks_RpgContentTriggerCheckCade: Minimum new messages before scanning recent RPG content for trigger signals.
STMemoryBooks_RpgContentTriggerCooldownD: Minimum messages after a content-triggered memory before another content trigger can fire.
STMemoryBooks_RpgManualReviewReadyDesc: RPG campaign memory mode is ready to create a memory for the selected message range.
STMemoryBooks_RpgManualReviewReadyDescRa: RPG campaign memory mode is ready to create a memory for messages {{start}}-{{end}}.
STMemoryBooks_RpgManualReviewQuestion: Create it now, or postpone the check?
